brief: Carries a W3C traceparent so one request can be followed as it hops across services and agent steps.
detail: A new object holds a fresh sampled context. SetHeader loads the header of an incoming request, and ChildHeader builds the header to propagate to a downstream call: same trace id, new span id. It is a pure value type with no I/O; the engine does the parsing and the random ids. A header that is not well-formed makes IsValid answer FALSE rather than raise.
